question: How much do regional capture and sex support influence the exposed age differences in deposited microglial cluster occupancy?
decision: Qualify regional and sex context before A25 state-versus-mixture modeling; determine whether fixed regional representation materially changes the descriptive source-cluster occupancy contrasts without claiming a new state.
strongest_rival: Age-associated whole-brain cluster occupancy partly reflects changing regional capture or sex composition; source clustering and processing can also structure the same cells.
discriminator: Estimate every deposited source cluster within each qualified mouse-region and compare equal-region versus captured-cell pooled fractions in the same complete-region mice. Retain all-sex, male-only and female-only support, including held old-female contrasts.
exposure_record: Exposed. Published atlas source occupancy and Nb5 descriptive/completion results were read. Existing case bridge, brain metadata and UMAP table headers/first rows were inspected. Source microglia and age/sex/region support are already public saved results. No new region-specific cluster contrast was computed before freeze; synthetic pure-region-mixture test only.
biological_unit: Deposited mouse; brain regions and cells are nested observations.
nesting_and_overlap: Repeated regions share mice and all outputs reuse Tabula Muris Senis animals. No new cohort, independent replication, longitudinal transition or cell-level population inference.
population_and_selection: All 13,130 exact-bridged case-object cells labelled microglial cell in both case and official annotations. Require source cell IDs unique and all joined age/mouse/sex/region labels concordant; strip terminal whitespace from region names only. Retain every source Leiden cluster. Each mouse-region needs 20 captured microglia; equal-region standardization requires all four named regions in that mouse.
contrast: 18-minus-3 and 24-minus-3-month equal-mouse mean cluster-fraction differences for cortex, cerebellum, hippocampus, striatum, pooled-all mice, pooled-complete-region mice and equal-region-complete mice; all, male, female scopes. Each contrast needs at least two mice at both ages solely for defined deletion sensitivity.
endpoint: Captured source-Leiden cluster fractions, per mouse/region and whole mouse; age mean differences in fraction units and leave-one-mouse-out ranges; complete-region unit identities and every failed eligibility cell.
methods: Count all source cluster IDs with zero counts retained within an observed qualified mouse-region. All-cell pooled fractions weight captured cells. Equal-region fractions average the four within-region fractions at weight 1/4 in mice qualified for all regions; compare with pooled fractions from those same mice. Age means weight mice equally. Enumerate all clusters and fixed scopes. Compute deletion ranges omitting each mouse in either age group; no resampled cells or significance tests. Independently reconstruct fractions from Python Counters and verify per-mouse/basis fractions sum to one.
missingness_and_exclusions: Record missing/under-20 mouse-regions and held comparisons with fewer than two mice at either age. Missing regions are never zero occupancy. Cluster absence within an observed eligible region is a zero. No relabeling of source clusters as published intermediate states or merging of ages/sexes to obtain eligibility.
multiplicity: No p values, ranking or significance labels; every cluster, sex scope, region basis and declared age comparison is retained.
precision_basis: At most 6/4/4 mice and all old mice male; missing regions reduce support. Two mice and twenty cells are descriptive eligibility conventions, not precision or power justification. Deletion ranges are not confidence intervals.
interpretation_limit: This describes captured proportions on exposed source cluster labels, not absolute cell abundance, functional microglial states, validated paper-state correspondence, independent replication, within-cell ageing transitions or an age effect adjusted for sex. A25 held-out state-versus-mixture model remains unrun.
stop_rule: Stop on duplicate cell IDs, discordant source annotations or age/mouse/sex/region joins, unexpected source microglia count, non-prespecified region or age labels. Preserve all failed support and unfavorable changes. Do not change cluster labels or floor after outcomes.
amendment_reason: New exposed descriptive extension qualifying region and sex context; preserves original source-occupancy reports and does not supersede their populations or complete A25 model design.
